dial.summary: 5/8 indicators supportive entering November 12 — DXY piercing 103.02 (highest since April 2025) on continued post-CPI repricing is the key headwind, but ISM Manufacturing at 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month), Global M2 trending up, real yields on a 4-week downtrend to 2.66%, and BTC funding drifting to a neutral 0.0045% post-liquidation flush all sustain the accumulation backdrop; BTC.D firm at 59.3% with TOTAL at ~$2.60T shows no alt-rotation signal yet.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) holds at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B); October G4 data not yet published — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month, so October G4 update expected mid-November 2026; US M2 at $23.4T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY per Macrotrends/FRED); 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds flat threshold — trend UP; status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction); held unchanged from Nov 11 run — October G4 data publication pending mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, 2026), beating consensus 54.6%, up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive expansion month; Production sub-index 59.0, New Orders 55.5, Prices 77.9 (9th consecutive above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next ISM Manufacturing release December 1, 2026 (November data); value unchanged — October 55.5 is the current monthly reading.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot 103.02 as of November 12, 2026 (CNBC: 103.022; FXStreet: 'DXY rises above 103.00, highest since April 2025, on firmer Fed hike expectations'); DXY continued rallying from the November 10 hot-CPI-driven move (102.07) cementing December FOMC hike expectations; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.5–101.8 on October 10 to 103.02 on November 12, net +~1.5%, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (DXY above 100 — must fall below 97.5 for supportive); FRED DTWEXBGS network-restricted in this environment.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.66% on November 9, 2026 (Federal Reserve H.15; Nov 6: 2.63%, Nov 5: 2.60%, per 24/7 Wall St. citing Fed H.15); Nov 10–11 readings not yet available; 4-week trend remains DOWN — from ~2.85–2.90% around October 10 (2026 high: 2.95% on Oct 5) to 2.66% on Nov 9, approximately -20 to -25bps; status supportive (falling 4-week trend — headwind requires BOTH rising trend AND above 2% simultaneously; value is above 2% but trend still down, only one condition met); FRED API network-restricted — confirmed via web source corroboration.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread narrowed to +25bps as of November 10, 2026 close (yieldcurve.pro: +25bps Nov 10, down 7bps on day; stockmarketwatch: 25bp; cap notes substack: 'flattened to 25bps from 32bps as 2Y rose 17bps on hot CPI'); 4-week trend FLAT — from approximately +28–32bps around October 10 to +25bps on November 10, approximately -3 to -7bps within or just at the flat threshold; 52-week range 20–74bps; status neutral (positive and recovering but flattening on hotter inflation data).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,748,145M ($6.748T) for week ended November 4, 2026 (FRED via govspending.org; weekly change +$2.51B WoW, +$175.41B YoY per macro research); next H.4.1 release November 12 at 4:30 PM ET for week ended November 11 — not yet published at run time; prior readings: Oct 28 $6,745,635M, Oct 21 $6,753,604M, Oct 14 $6,755,639M; 4-week change Oct 7 → Nov 4: balance sheet oscillating in a narrow ~$10B band, essentially flat; balance sheet stabilized post-QT-pause (QT ended December 2025); YoY +2.6%; status supportive (flat, no aggressive QT); FRED API network-restricted — WALCL confirmed via web source corroboration.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass OI-weighted BTC perp funding rate 0.0045% (4.9% annualized, labeled Neutral by CoinGlass) as of November 12, 2026 01:51 UTC+8; prior readings: 0.0063% (Nov 11, The Coin Republic citing CoinGlass), 0.0078% (Nov 11, CoinDesk: '8.6% annualized, below 0.01% baseline'), 0.0087% position-weighted (Nov 8, ChainCatcher); drift down from 0.0087% (Nov 8) to 0.0045% (Nov 12); 30-day trend FLAT — late-September rates were near zero/negative, now 0.0045%, slightly up on a 30-day basis but within noise; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold); post-liquidation flush (Nov 8–9: $1.04B+ in long liquidations) normalizing to neutral confirms no speculative excess, consistent with accumulation.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap $286.9B as of November 12, 2026 (DefiLlama); TOTAL crypto market cap ~$2.60T (BTC.D at 59.3% per tv-hub.org, Nov 2026); implied stablecoin dominance ~11.0% ($286.9B/$2600B); 30-day trend UP — October 1 dominance ~10.2% ($291B/$2.86T), rising as TOTAL declined sharply while stablecoins held near $287–291B; status neutral — headwind requires rising dominance AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL declined from Oct 1 level ($2.60T vs $2.86T, -9%) so headwind condition not met; dominance rising so supportive condition not met either; stablecoin supply itself has been contracting from May 2026 peak ($309.7B) adding nuance.

upcoming.title: PPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Producer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET; completes the November inflation picture alongside October CPI (+0.4% MoM, released Nov 10 — hot vs +0.3% consensus); September PPI was +6.3% YoY and ISM Manufacturing Prices remains elevated at 77.9; a hot PPI print would amplify the December FOMC hike case; oil's ~6% drop to $85 on Nov 9 may moderate the energy component of headline PPI.

upcoming.title: US Retail Sales (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases October 2026 Advance Monthly Retail Trade Survey at 8:30 AM ET; September retail sales were +0.8% MoM (well above the +0.3% forecast); a print above +0.5% MoM would add to the already-strong December hike case after the hot October CPI (+0.4% MoM); a miss near 0% would add soft-landing ambiguity but is unlikely to outweigh the inflation surprise; this is the last major growth read before the FOMC blackout period begins November 28.

upcoming.title: Industrial Production (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases October 2026 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization (G.17) at 9:15 AM ET; September industrial production rose +0.4% MoM; a continued expansion would corroborate the October ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month); Fed plans an annual G.17 revision release on November 24, so this reading may be subject to revision.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases October 2026 New Residential Construction at 8:30 AM ET; elevated mortgage rates (30Y near 7.1%) and real yields at 2.66% (down from 2.90% but historically high) continue to pressure housing affordability; after the hot CPI print sealing higher-for-longer expectations, a sharp drop in permits would underscore the housing drag on Q4 2026 growth.

upcoming.title: FOMC Minutes — October 27–28 Meeting
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases minutes of the October 27–28 FOMC meeting at 2:00 PM ET; the Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% (vote 10–2) at that meeting; minutes will reveal member views on the threshold for a December 9 hike given elevated ISM Prices (77.9) and Iran-war supply shocks; the November 10 hot CPI print (+0.4% MoM) arrived after the October meeting, so the minutes predate it — markets will read them against the new inflation reality; FOMC blackout period begins November 28.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 15, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL releases weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET on Thursday November 19; final weekly labor read before Thanksgiving disruption and the November 28 FOMC blackout; a sustained trend above 220K would pressure December hike odds; next NFP release is December 4 (November data), which arrives just before the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Index (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia releases November 2026 Manufacturing Business Outlook Survey at 8:30 AM ET; provides a first-look at November manufacturing activity ahead of the December 1 ISM Manufacturing PMI; a positive print above 0 would reinforce the October ISM signal at 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month); released on the third Thursday of the month.
